title: Clamped displacement + a backing box at that depth = hidden z-fight
summary: Clamping relief pits makes flat plateaus at the exact depth of a filler box behind the face: FLICKER at 6,400 px. Keep backing volumes at least .3 m behind the face.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: backing(w, h, depth, mat)   // front face .3 m behind the relief plane

doc.when: Any displaced surface with geometry behind it.
doc.avoid: Backing boxes flush with the relief plane.
gotchas: The flicker check catching it is good: don't silence it.

problem.symptom: FLICKER thousands of px on an earth face.
problem.cause: Clamped relief plateaus coincide with a box face behind the relief.
problem.fix: Move filler/backing boxes .3 m+ behind the face.
problem.detect: FLICKER on a relief region; plateaus visible in a wireframe.
